description: This is a C# source file defining the ImportController class for handling deployment package imports in an OrchardCore module, including file upload, JSON import, and error handling.

classes.name: ImportController
classes.description: Controller for handling deployment package import operations, including file uploads and JSON imports, with authorization and notification support.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Displays the import page after authorization check.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Handles uploaded deployment package files, extracts or moves them, and initiates import process with error handling.

methods.name: Json
methods.description: Displays the JSON import page after authorization check.

methods.name: Json (POST)
methods.description: Processes JSON input for deployment import, validates JSON, writes to temp folder, and initiates import with error handling.
